apps.localizedDescription: A SwiftUI Reddit client following Apollo and Apollo Reborn. You need your own Reddit API client ID. The IPA is unsigned; AltStore or SideStore signs it on your device.

versions.localizedDescription:
Phoebus 0.2.0 is everything since 0.1.0: settings are now thirteen task-based categories with live previews, Phoebus has its own app icons, and Reddit's current awards, chat requests and chat muting work natively.

Highlights
• Thirteen task-based settings categories, with live previews for posts, threads, swipes, action menus and filters.
• Phoebus's own app icons (Phoebus and Always Dark packs), and none of Apollo's artwork.
• Reddit's current awards, native chat-request answers, muting and unmuting chat rooms, and collapse choices that survive leaving a thread.
• Gallery tile sizes, Saved Gallery View, media hold menus, Downvote Tap and a New Comments jump mode.
• Feeds that load again when Reddit blocks www, and an error message that no longer calls a blocked feed private.

Before you update
• Settings were regrouped and several screens were renamed. Settings values, per-account overrides and backups are unchanged.
• Apollo's original icons and the community icon packs are removed. If you had picked one, choose a Phoebus icon again under Appearance > Theme > App Icon.
• Wallpapers are gone. Old backups still import cleanly.
• Awards need a reddit.com web sign-in.

Tested with automated checks, an emulated iOS runtime and one iPhone on iOS 27. Requires iOS 17 or later.

Full notes with screenshots: https://github.com/pendo324/Phoebus/releases/tag/v0.2.0

privacy.NSCrossWebsiteTrackingUsageDescription: Lets the YouTube player use the YouTube account you sign in to, for Premium, watch history and age-restricted videos.
privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Used to reach a notification backend or Bark server you host on your own network.
privacy.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Your approximate location is checked once to calculate sunset and sunrise for automatic theme switching. It is not shared or sent.
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Used to save images, GIFs, and videos you choose to your Photos library.
